player_profile.name: Serhou Guirassy
player_profile.bio: Powerful aerial focal point with calm close-range composure and strong hold-up play under Bundesliga pressing traps.

player_profile.name: Harry Kane
player_profile.bio: Elite two-way center forward combining lethal finishing from any range with quarterbacked long-range switches into wide runners.

player_profile.name: Ritsu Dōan
player_profile.bio: Low-center-of-gravity wide creator who cuts inside onto his left foot to deliver curled shots and back-post service.

player_profile.name: Xavi Simons
player_profile.bio: Explosive half-space carrier with tight-space dribbling, relentless counter-pressing, and incisive final-third through balls.

player_profile.name: Patrik Schick
player_profile.bio: Tall, silky left-footed striker who excels at attacking near-post crosses and carving out high-value central chances.

player_profile.name: Marvin Ducksch
player_profile.bio: Dead-ball specialist and clever shadow striker whose first-time flicks and set-piece delivery drive Bremen's attack.

player_profile.name: Hugo Ekitiké
player_profile.bio: Fluid, long-striding striker who drifts into the left channel to isolate center-backs and accelerate vertical transitions.

player_profile.name: Deniz Undav
player_profile.bio: Relentless penalty-box poacher who links midfield and attack with sharp one-touch combinations and high-volume shooting inside the area.

player_profile.name: Fisnik Asllani
player_profile.bio: Tall yet nimble striker combining sharp link-up play with composed finishing inside the penalty area.

player_profile.name: Alexis Claude-Maurice
player_profile.bio: Quick-footed attacking midfielder who attacks pockets between the lines and stretches defenses with direct ball carries.

player_profile.name: Andrej Kramarić
player_profile.bio: Hoffenheim's all-time top scorer; a cerebral final-third operator with deceptive movement and ruthless finishing.

player_profile.name: Davie Selke
player_profile.bio: Commanding target striker who pins center-backs, wins first contacts, and converts high-volume deliveries in the box.

player_profile.name: Silvan Widmer
player_profile.bio: Experienced Swiss international providing leadership, overlapping width, and disciplined back-post defending.

player_profile.name: Dejan Ljubičić
player_profile.bio: Tireless central midfielder who covers huge ground, disrupts build-up play, and arrives late into the penalty box.

player_profile.name: Markus Schubert
player_profile.bio: Agile shot-stopper comfortable stepping off his line to initiate Paderborn's progressive build-up from the back.

player_profile.name: Dominick Drexler
player_profile.bio: Experienced Bundesliga playmaker bringing composure, clever spacing, and sharp combination play in tight zones.

player_profile.name: Benedict Hollerbach
player_profile.bio: High-tempo vertical runner who thrives in direct counter-attacks and relentlessly harasses opposing backlines.

player_profile.name: Tim Kleindienst
player_profile.bio: Dominant physical striker who leads the press from the front and punishes crosses with elite aerial timing.
